rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) cap of 5% (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: The Annual General Adjustment, the amount by which the landlord of a fully-covered rental unit may raise the rent each year, is set by the Rent Board using a Consumer Price Index formula. It may be no more than 5% even if the formula yields more.
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered rental units under Berkeley's Rent Ordinance. Government-owned or -subsidized units are now fully or partially covered depending on unit type.
rules.exemptions: The cap does not prevent a landlord with banked (unused) AGAs from previous years from raising rent by more than 5% up to the rent ceiling. A unit where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord is exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.interaction_text: Whether a unit is fully or partially covered depends on unit type and if Federal law, State law, or administrative regulation exempts the unit from the rent control provisions of Berkeley’s Rent Ordinance.

rules.title: Capital improvement rent increase petitions limited to completed improvements (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: Landlords may only petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements. They can no longer petition for preliminary authorization of rent increases for planned capital improvements.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords seeking rent increases through the Rent Board petition process.
rules.quoted_span: Landlords can only file a petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements (they can no longer petition to have rent increases preliminarily authorized for planned capital improvements).

rules.title: Minimum rental debt for nonpayment eviction (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict for nonpayment of rent only if the tenant owes rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the HUD Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size in the Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR area for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.key_value: Rental debt >= one month of Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size (Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: A unit where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord is exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.

rules.title: No eviction for refusing to sign a substantially similar lease (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease when a fixed-term lease expires.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.

rules.title: Requirements for eviction based on breach of a material lease term (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: To evict for violating a material lease term, the term must be mutually agreed, the violation must cause substantial, actual damage to the landlord, and the landlord must show the tenant's behavior was unreasonable. The required notice to stop the violation must specify the lease term and describe the violation and resulting harm in enough detail for a reasonable person to understand.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord’s notice to the tenant to stop the violation (which is required before the landlord can serve an eviction notice) must specify the lease term, and describe the violation and resulting harm in enough detail for a reasonable person to understand.

rules.title: Required Rent Board information in termination notices (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: Any notice terminating a tenancy must state that advice about the notice is available from the Rent Board and give the Rent Board's current housing counseling phone number and website address.
rules.coverage_text: Notices terminating tenancies in units covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: Any notice terminating a tenancy must contain a statement that advice about the notice is available from the Rent Board, the current phone number for the Rent Board’s Housing counseling services, and the current address of the Rent Board’s website.

rules.title: Filing eviction notices and lawsuits with the Rent Board (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after serving the tenant.
rules.key_value: Within three business days of service
rules.coverage_text: Landlords of units covered by the Rent Ordinance who serve eviction notices or eviction lawsuits.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.

rules.title: Mandatory annual adjustment of owner move-in relocation assistance (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.coverage_text: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance payments under the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
